note: Single source for the origins the app may connect to and for the Permissions-Policy values (Session T, ADR-012). security-policy.ts, next.config.ts, lib/ai/providers.ts and the deployment checks read this file, through lib/csp-compose.mjs for the policies (Session W); no literal copies elsewhere.

serverOnly.note: Origins only the app's own server code reaches, never the browser: none of them enters connect-src (ADR-014 S2). Each is a secret on the app Worker, unset in every committed config. Since Session AF the list also names fixed public origins the server reads (chainRelay, earnLive, recipeResolver, rampAssets, practiceBadges); those are not secrets, and none of them enters connect-src except the testnet LCD, which the browser also reads directly (chainOrigins); the mainnet LCD api.zigchain.com stays server-only.
serverOnly.exchangeRelay: Session AI (J14; TIER 3 egress routes): /api/exchange forwards only the listed read-only calls to https://api.kraken.com, https://api.coinbase.com and https://api.binance.com (lib/exchanges/allowlist.ts); fixed public origins, not secrets; never in connect-src (the browser calls only its own origin)
serverOnly.zigiRelay: ZIGOALS_ZIGI_RELAY_ORIGIN: ZIGoals hosted's relay (workers/zigi-relay), reached only by /api/zigi (lib/server/zigi-route.ts); off by default
serverOnly.healthLink: ZIGOALS_HEALTH_LINK_ORIGIN: the health-link Worker (workers/health-link), reached only by /api/health-link (lib/server/health-link-route.ts); off by default
serverOnly.pushReminders: ZIGOALS_PUSH_ORIGIN: the push-reminders Worker (workers/push-reminders), reached only by /api/push (lib/server/push-route.ts); off until the owner activates push (docs/run11/PUSH_ACTIVATION.md). Listed by Session X Part 8: it has been server-only since ADR-010
serverOnly.fdcBranded: Session AK (Part 1b; TIER 3 egress routes): https://api.nal.usda.gov (USDA FoodData Central foods/search, dataType=Branded), reached only by the food Worker (workers/food-lookup) after Open Food Facts answers not found, and only when the owner sets the Worker secret FDC_API_KEY (sent as X-Api-Key, never in a URL); only the barcode and the User-Agent travel; never in connect-src
serverOnly.pushDevice: ZIGOALS_PUSH_DEVICE_ORIGIN: the device push Worker (workers/push-device, Session AK Part 2, ADR-036 Q3), reached only by /api/push-device (lib/server/push-device-route.ts) with a random device id and secret, a push endpoint, a zone, quiet hours and wake minutes — never a name, kind, count or amount; off until the owner activates it (docs/run11/PUSH_PUBLIC_ALPHA.md). The Worker posts payload-free pushes only to the push-service hosts of workers/push-reminders/hosts.mjs.
serverOnly.chainRelay: Fixed public origins, not secrets: https://api.zigchain.com and https://testnet-api.zigchain.com, reached by /api/positions (lib/server/positions-relay.ts), /api/chain/validators (lib/server/chain-validators.ts) and /api/chain/proposals, /proposal, /vote and /grants (lib/server/chain-governance.ts, chain-grants.ts through chain-lcd.ts) for reads at one block height; the browser reaches only the RPC hosts in chainOrigins (Session AF, ADR-028 H16)
serverOnly.earnLive: Fixed public origins, not secrets: https://api.zigchain.com, https://testnet-api.zigchain.com, https://zigchain-api.polkachu.com, https://api.llama.fi and https://yields.llama.fi, reached only by /api/earn/* (chain, valdora, oroswap, defillama, vaults, measured; lib/server/earn/upstream.ts EARN_EGRESS), address-free except the measured figure's one validator's own public account (Session AF, ADR-028 H16, H97)
serverOnly.recipeResolver: A fixed public origin, not a secret: https://cloudflare-dns.com (DNS-over-HTTPS), reached only by /api/recipe-import before it fetches a recipe page, to refuse a host that resolves to a private address (lib/server/recipe-resolve.ts RECIPE_RESOLVER; Session AF Part 11 A10, ADR-028 H71)
serverOnly.rampAssets: A fixed public origin, not a secret: https://api.rampnetwork.com, reached only by /api/onramps/ramp-assets (lib/onramps/server/ramp-assets.ts RAMP_EGRESS) for Ramp Network's public asset list, minimums and fees; address-free, cached for an hour (Session AF Part 4, ADR-028 H35)
serverOnly.practiceBadges: A fixed public origin, not a secret: https://zigchain-testnet-api.polkachu.com (Polkachu's public testnet LCD), reached only by /api/chain/attestations (lib/server/chain-attestations.ts ATTESTATION_SOURCE) for a sender-scoped testnet transaction search when the person presses "Check them on the chain" (the official LCD blocks tx searches); testnet only (Session AF, ADR-028 H48, H105)

csp.note: Session W Part 14: /app documents reach chess.com's and Lichess's public APIs (connect) and frame exactly their daily puzzle, puzzle, TV and game pages (frame), docs/product/CHESS.md. Session W Part 20: /app documents reach Spotify's accounts service (the PKCE token exchange and refresh) and Web API (the player), and show artwork from Spotify's image host, only once the person connects Spotify, docs/product/MUSIC_ACTIVATION.md. Session W Part 1e: extra connect-src, img-src and frame-src sources per document class ('app' is /app and everything under it, 'site' every other document), in the order they are sent. lib/csp-compose.mjs builds the one policy the app and every check use. Empty lists keep the policy every build since Session V sends: connect-src is 'self' plus the origins above, img-src 'self' data: blob:, frame-src 'none'. Session AF (ADR-028 H16 (c)/(d), lane L2b): /app documents read the balances of wallets the person linked browser-direct, each address only from its own chain's host: PublicNode's Cosmos REST (ATOM of a linked ZIGChain key), its six EVM JSON-RPC hosts (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain), its Solana RPC, and mempool.space (Bitcoin); ZIGoals' server never sees those addresses (apps/web/lib/wallets/balances/chains.ts holds the same list). Session AK (Part 1a, TIER 3 (CSP), ADR-036): with the owner's Reown project id set, /app documents reach WalletConnect's relay socket (wss://relay.walletconnect.org) and its Verify API, and frame Verify's attestation page (verify.walletconnect.org and .com), exactly the hosts @walletconnect/sign-client 2.26.0 reaches with telemetry off (docs/research/session-ak/WALLETS.md); the package loads only when a person taps Connect on phone.
